name: Kiwi Krew Gaming
description: Level up your game with Kiwi Krew Gaming's top-tier peripherals.
story: Kiwi Krew Gaming is a New Zealand-based esports brand looking to branch out into traditional motorsports. They believe in supporting local talent and see racing as a natural extension of their competitive spirit. They want to connect with a young, engaged audience and showcase their products in a high-octane environment.
